decision.explanation: Conflicting information exists: one document associates Torcy-et-Pouligny with the canton of Auterive, citing studies and an official recognition in 2018, while another identifies it as part of the canton of Semur-en-Auxois, referencing INSEE, the Côte-d'Or department, and the French Ministry of the Interior.
